title: Making Weekend Plans
summaryZh: 兩個朋友聊上週末的活動，並約好這個週末一起去爬山、吃晚餐。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hey Sam, what did you end up doing last weekend?
sentences.zh: 嘿 Sam，你上週末最後做了什麼？
sentences.note: did you → /dɪdʒə/，d 和 y 合併成 /dʒ/ 音。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I stayed home mostly, but I finally cleaned out my closet.
sentences.zh: 我大部分時間都待在家，不過總算把衣櫃整理乾淨了。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: That sounds boring, but it must feel really good now.
sentences.zh: 聽起來很無聊，不過現在應該很有成就感吧。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: It does. What about you? Did you go anywhere fun?
sentences.zh: 確實。那你呢？你有去什麼好玩的地方嗎？
sentences.note: What about you → /wʌɾəbaʊtʃu/，What 的 t 變閃音，about you 連成 /baʊtʃu/。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I drove up to the coast with my sister on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 我星期六跟我姊姊開車去了海邊。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: We walked along the beach and ate way too much seafood.
sentences.zh: 我們沿著海灘散步，還吃了太多海鮮。
sentences.note: walked along → /wɔːktəlɔŋ/，walked 的字尾 /t/ 接母音要連讀。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Now I'm jealous. I haven't seen the ocean in months.
sentences.zh: 我現在有點羨慕。我已經好幾個月沒看到海了。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Then come with us this weekend. We're hiking on Sunday morning.
sentences.zh: 那這個週末跟我們一起去吧。我們星期天早上要去爬山。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Really? How long is the hike? I'm not in great shape.
sentences.zh: 真的嗎？要爬多久？我體力沒有很好。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: It's about two hours up, and the view is worth it.
sentences.zh: 上去大概兩個小時，但那個風景絕對值得。
sentences.note: worth it → /wɝːθɪt/，兩字連讀，it 弱讀成 /ɪt/ 甚至 /ət/。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Okay, I'm in. What time will you pick me up?
sentences.zh: 好，我加入。你幾點來接我？
sentences.note: will you → /wɪljə/，you 弱讀成 /jə/；pick me up 連成一串。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I'll grab you at seven, before the parking lot fills up.
sentences.zh: 我七點去接你，趁停車場還沒停滿。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Seven is early, but I'll set two alarms just in case.
sentences.zh: 七點好早，不過我會設兩個鬧鐘以防萬一。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Perfect. We'll get dinner after, and I'm buying this time.
sentences.zh: 太好了。爬完我們去吃晚餐，這次我請客。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: You said that last time, but I'll let you try again.
sentences.zh: 你上次也是這樣說，不過我就再給你一次機會。
sentences.note: let you → /lɛtʃu/，t 和 y 合併成 /tʃ/ 音。

questions.q: What did Sam do last weekend?
options: Cleaned out his closet at home

questions.q: What are they planning to do on Sunday?
options: A long dinner in the city

questions.q: Why does A want to leave at seven?
options: They have to be back early
The hike takes over two hours
The parking lot fills up later
